## About
Rich and Famous Auto Body is a body and paint shop on Bessemer St in Van Nuys. We handle collision repair, frame repair, paint repair and dent repair for all makes and models, and we also take on high end luxury and exotic cars.
Folks come to us from around the San Fernando Valley and greater Los Angeles, including Woodland Hills, Tarzana, Encino, Sherman Oaks, Studio City and North Hollywood. We stand behind our work with a lifetime warranty on parts and labor.
Our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 66 Google reviews. They tell us they like that we explain things clearly, keep pricing reasonable and don't push work you don't need.

## Services
- Collision repair: Getting your car back in shape after an accident.
- Frame repair: Repairing frame damage so the car sits and drives right again.
- Paint and dent repair: Fixing dents and paint damage on all makes and models.
- Luxury and exotic body work: Body, paint and collision work on makes like Mercedes Benz, Porsche, BMW, Tesla, Lamborghini, Bentley and Ferrari.
- Maintenance: Customers also bring their cars in for routine maintenance like oil changes and brake pads.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all auto insurance companies, including Allstate, Geico, State Farm, Farmers, Mercury, AAA, Progressive, USAA, Liberty Mutual, Travelers and many others.

Q: Do estimates cost anything?
A: No. Estimates are free. Give us a call or stop by the shop on Bessemer St.

Q: Can I come in on a weekend?
A: Saturdays and Sundays are by appointment, so please call ahead and we'll set up a time.
